summary: 发票税额资格确认与跨 owner 编排（复用 PH-252）on BASE 863f946. Does not reimplement invoice record/tax split/reversal: those stay in PH-252. Adds invoicing/migrations/0002_tax_qualification_guard.py which replaces only the TaxQualification append-only guard with vendor-aware SQLite/PG rules allowing pending->confirmed (recoverable/not_recoverable, decided_on/evidence/version change) and confirmed->superseded (status/version only), while keeping source_ref/tax_cents/created_at immutable and DELETE forbidden. Adds services: open_tax_qualification (pending fact for an existing invoice/line/allocation/reversal source, tax <= source tax), confirm_tax_qualification (owner/finance, company lock, request_token/expected_version, period/lock checks, evidence, plugin audit, no ledger/cost/revenue/cash writes), supersede_tax_qualification (old confirmed->superseded plus appended replacement confirmed fact preserving history), and link_invoice_orchestration (validates invoice/reversal ownership and the referenced owner fact for management-revenue reversal / cash refund / bank return / settlement adjustment incl. settlement/clearance/open-item refs; records the append-only reference chain in AuditEvent with plugin action, does not mutate other owners and does not claim a global single transaction). Adds read-only invoice_tax_snapshot/list with qualification history, effective qualification, orchestration reference chain and frozen issues (tax_qualification_missing/pending/superseded, orchestration_ref_missing, not_recoverable_costing_review_required); missing is null+missing, never zero. Adds invoicing/invoice_tax.html plus invoice-tax history_read page and invoice-tax-confirm/link business_write routes (owner/finance write, auditor read, member denied, disabled-module history read). No new canonical topic/command, no contract schema or applied-migration edits, no other-owner writes. Tests: 8 scoped (4 service incl. append-only/DB trigger probes, supersede, permissions/period, orchestration chain after reversal; 3 HTTP; plus existing PH-252 invoice suite). Actual runs: check ok/task_count=263; manage.py check exit0; makemigrations no changes; fresh SQLite verify ok; scoped 8 OK; full 1169/140.002s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures. Deviations: PM project-level summary is impossible because Invoice has no project FK, so PM is denied detail/list (disclosed); orchestration is reference recording/validation only (owner writes must be performed first by the corresponding named owner service; invoicing does not invoke them), so no false single-transaction claim; no tax/orchestration verifier branch because core verify_integrity is outside the PH-320 allowlist (fresh DB passes; trigger probes included in tests); models.py unchanged.

tests.evidence: Actual run exit 0; 105 known URL/field-system warnings, no errors.
Actual run: 'No changes detected'; the only new migration is invoicing/0002_tax_qualification_guard.py and no applied migration is modified.

Actual final run: Ran 1169 tests in 133.738s, 5 failures/3 errors/69 environment skips. The 8 failure/error names are exactly the known macOS environment-limited baseline (6 DRF Accept/codec/large-JSON, 2 delivery symlink); no new names. Linux/PostgreSQL CI is authoritative.

Actual run: Ran 8 tests, OK. Service 5: pending->confirmed append-only with no owner facts; duplicate/supersede with effective replacement; permissions/period/append-only DB trigger probes (savepoint-safe); orchestration settlement link/duplicate/missing ref; reversal reference chain. HTTP 3: owner page+confirm; link/invalid posts; roles and disabled-module history read. Existing PH-252 invoice suite also passes (22 tests incl. new scope).
Actual run before review pass: only high_risk_review_required (review pending), no path_out_of_scope. Will be rerun and set pass after the independent reviewer status=pass.
Actual BASE acceptance run: Ran 18 tests, OK. Reused PH-252 invoice record/allocate/reverse suite remains green after the TaxQualification guard relaxation and the new tax/orchestration services.

review.evidence: 待独立复核：按 BASE 863f946 的 PH-320/ADR 0015/PH-252 核对：未重实现 record/allocate/reverse；TaxQualification trigger 仅放宽 pending→confirmed/confirmed→superseded 且不可改 source/tax/created/DELETE；确认服务权限/幂等/expected_version/期间/证据/审计且不写 owner 事实；supersede 历史链与有效资格；跨 owner 引用链只记录/校验、不声称单事务、不写其它 owner；只读投影/issue/missing；页面权限/停用 history_read；无 canonical/schema/已应用迁移变更；scoped/full/verify_integrity；PM 无法按项目收敛与 verifier 分支缺失等偏差披露。实现者不自写 pass。

deviations: PH-252 的 record/价税分离/红冲基础未重实现；仅在 TaxQualification 上新增 append-only 状态迁移 trigger（migration 0002）与编排/只读服务。
跨 owner 编排实现为“owner 事实现有后，invoicing 校验并记录引用链”：不直接调用/改写 management_revenue/cash/settlement，也不声称单事务；owner 写必须先经各自具名服务完成，report/页面明确说明。
PM 项目摘要无法收敛：Invoice 模型无 project FK（PH-252 范围），本片对 pm 的税额/编排详情与列表拒绝，pm 只能使用其它按项目收敛的只读页面；已在 report/handoff 披露。
verify_integrity 无税额/编排专门分支（core/management/commands/verify_integrity.py 不在 PH-320 白名单）；fresh DB verify 通过，trigger 探针在 scoped tests 内覆盖；不新增 canonical topic/command。
未修改 models.py（TaxQualification 字段复用 status/qualification_status/decided_on/evidence/version）；编排引用存于 append-only AuditEvent payload，不新增内部链接表。
非 CNY/多币种税额映射未在本片范围；PG CI/浏览器/生产未验证。
